title: Term Exam — General Science Term 2
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Which reaction type needs a fuel and oxygen and gives off heat and light?
options: Combustion
Decomposition of a compound
Acid reacting with a metal
Acid reacting with a carbonate
questions.correct: Combustion

questions.text: Which gas puts out a burning splint?
options: Carbon dioxide
Hydrogen gas (H₂)
Oxygen gas (O₂)
Methane gas (CH₄)
questions.correct: Carbon dioxide

questions.text: Why does vinegar remove limescale from a faucet?
options: Its acid reacts with the carbonate in the scale
Its water melts the scale into a liquid form slowly
Its smell drives the minerals away from the metal
It cools the faucet so the scale cracks and falls
questions.correct: Its acid reacts with the carbonate in the scale

questions.text: Which daily activity involves an acid reacting with a carbonate?
options: Baking powder making a cake rise
An LPG stove heating a pot of rice on the burner
Hydrogen peroxide fizzing on a fresh wound
A rusty nail forming in a wet backyard
questions.correct: Baking powder making a cake rise

questions.text: What makes incomplete combustion dangerous indoors?
options: It produces carbon monoxide
It produces extra pure oxygen in the room
It produces only harmless water vapor
It makes the flame burn completely blue
questions.correct: It produces carbon monoxide

questions.text: A metal spoon is dropped into muriatic acid and bubbles form. What should you expect if a flame is brought near the bubbles?
options: A squeaky pop, since hydrogen formed
The flame goes out, since carbon dioxide formed
A bright glow, since pure oxygen formed
Nothing at all, since no gas can form here
questions.correct: A squeaky pop, since hydrogen formed

questions.text: Which equation is balanced?
options: N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃
N₂ + H₂ → NH₃
N₂ + 3H₂ → NH₃
2N₂ + H₂ → 2NH₃
questions.correct: N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃

questions.text: What is the energy source for photosynthesis?
options: Light energy
Heat from the soil
Chemical energy in glucose
Sound energy from wind
questions.correct: Light energy

questions.text: What does yeast produce during fermentation?
options: Alcohol and carbon dioxide
Lactic acid and pure oxygen gas
Glucose and pure oxygen gas
Water and a lot of ATP
questions.correct: Alcohol and carbon dioxide

questions.text: Which organisms carry out cellular respiration?
options: Almost all living things, including plants
Only animals, since plants make their own food
Only plants, since animals eat their food
Only bacteria that live in the soil
questions.correct: Almost all living things, including plants

questions.text: How many oxygen atoms are on the LEFT side of C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂?
In a sealed jar, a plant is kept in the dark for two days. What happens to the CO₂ level, and why?
options: It rises, because the plant respires but cannot photosynthesize
It falls, because the plant photosynthesizes even more in the dark
It stays the same, because plants stop all reactions at night
It falls to zero, because darkness destroys carbon dioxide
questions.correct: It rises, because the plant respires but cannot photosynthesize

questions.text: Which pair is a solute and solvent in that order?
options: Sugar and water in coffee
Water and sugar in coffee
Air and nitrogen in the sky
Steel and iron in a nail
questions.correct: Sugar and water in coffee

questions.text: Which can separate salt from seawater?
options: Evaporation
Filtering with paper
Shaking the bottle
Letting it settle
questions.correct: Evaporation

questions.text: Why does stirring help sugar dissolve faster?
options: It brings fresh solvent into contact with the solute
It makes the sugar crystals much bigger and heavier than before
It removes the water from around the sugar
It cools the solution so more can dissolve
questions.correct: It brings fresh solvent into contact with the solute

questions.text: Which is a LIQUID-in-LIQUID solution?
options: Vinegar
Brass (alloy)
Soda
Air
questions.correct: Vinegar

questions.text: A farmer's field was flooded by seawater during a storm surge. Based on solution science, what will most likely happen to his rice?
options: It wilts, since salty soil pulls water from the roots
It grows taller, since salt is an important plant nutrient
It is unharmed, since rice can filter the salt
It turns sweet, since salt changes into sugar
questions.correct: It wilts, since salty soil pulls water from the roots

questions.text: Fish in a pond gasp at the surface on hot afternoons but not in the early morning. What BEST explains this?
options: Warm water holds less dissolved oxygen
Cold water holds less dissolved oxygen
Fish need less oxygen when it is hot
Sunlight removes all salt from the pond
questions.correct: Warm water holds less dissolved oxygen

questions.text: What does the exclamation-mark GHS pictogram indicate?
options: An irritant or harmful substance
A chemical that explodes on impact
A gas under high pressure inside
A substance that is very radioactive
questions.correct: An irritant or harmful substance

questions.text: Why should chemicals be kept in their original containers?
options: The label shows contents, hazards and first aid
Original containers make chemicals much stronger
Other containers make the chemicals evaporate
Only original containers are allowed in stores
questions.correct: The label shows contents, hazards and first aid

questions.text: How does mercury reach people who live far from a mine?
options: It accumulates in fish that people eat
It travels through the electric power lines
It is added to rice during harvest time
It falls with the rain as tiny pure crystals
questions.correct: It accumulates in fish that people eat

questions.text: Which is the safest way to dispose of leftover paint thinner?
options: Bring it to a hazardous-waste collection point
Pour it into the canal behind the house slowly
Burn it in the backyard in an open steel drum
Mix it with soil and use it as garden fertilizer
questions.correct: Bring it to a hazardous-waste collection point

questions.text: A school stores muriatic acid beside bleach on one open shelf. Which risk is GREATEST?
options: A leak could mix them and release toxic gas
The bleach will make the acid more expensive
The acid will cause the bleach to evaporate
The shelf will make both chemicals expire
questions.correct: A leak could mix them and release toxic gas

questions.text: Two barangays reduce creek pollution: X fines dumping and offers used-oil collection; Y posts one sign. Which approach is MORE effective?
options: X — it changes behavior and gives a safe option
Y — a single sign is enough to stop all dumping
Y — fines always make dumping happen more often
X — because fines make creeks naturally cleaner
questions.correct: X — it changes behavior and gives a safe option

questions.text: Which level of organization is the heart?
options: Organ
Tissue
Organ system
Cell
questions.correct: Organ

questions.text: Which feature of root hairs matches their function?
options: Long and thin, giving more area to absorb water
Thick and hard, protecting the plant from insects
Green and flat, capturing sunlight for food
Hollow and dead, carrying sugar to the flowers
questions.correct: Long and thin, giving more area to absorb water

questions.text: Which is an example of homeostasis?
options: Shivering to warm up when cold
Growing taller during adolescence
Passing eye color to a child
Bees carrying pollen to flowers
questions.correct: Shivering to warm up when cold

questions.text: What makes something alive rather than non-living?
options: It has cells and carries out life processes
It moves quickly and makes a loud sound
It grows larger when it is heated up
It changes its color whenever bright sunlight hits it
questions.correct: It has cells and carries out life processes

questions.text: Emphysema reduces the number of alveoli. Why does this make the heart work harder?
options: Blood carries less oxygen, so the heart pumps faster to compensate
The heart must pump air directly into the lungs to replace the alveoli
The alveoli move into the heart and block its chambers
Less carbon dioxide reaches the heart, so it beats slowly
questions.correct: Blood carries less oxygen, so the heart pumps faster to compensate

questions.text: Which diagram BEST shows structure–function in the digestive system?
options: Villi drawn with an arrow to 'more area for absorption'
Stomach drawn with an arrow to 'pumps blood to the body'
Teeth drawn with an arrow to 'exchange oxygen and CO₂'
Liver drawn with an arrow to 'captures sunlight for food'
questions.correct: Villi drawn with an arrow to 'more area for absorption'

questions.text: Which organelle carries out photosynthesis?
options: Chloroplast
Mitochondrion
Ribosome
Nucleus
questions.correct: Chloroplast

questions.text: What is the 'energy currency' of the cell?
options: ATP
DNA
Glucose
Oxygen
questions.correct: ATP

questions.text: Which process uses ATP to move substances against the concentration gradient?
options: Active transport
Simple diffusion
Osmosis of water
Facilitated diffusion
questions.correct: Active transport

questions.text: Why do plant cells keep their shape better than animal cells when they gain water?
options: They have a rigid cell wall
They have no cell membrane
They contain no water inside
They have more mitochondria
questions.correct: They have a rigid cell wall

questions.text: Why does aerobic respiration release far more ATP than anaerobic respiration?
options: Oxygen lets glucose be broken down completely
Anaerobic respiration uses more glucose at once
Oxygen adds extra glucose to every cell
Aerobic respiration happens in the cytoplasm
questions.correct: Oxygen lets glucose be broken down completely

questions.text: A slice of raw papaya is put in plain water and another in sugar syrup. Which slice becomes softer and smaller?
options: The one in sugar syrup
The one in plain water
Both shrink equally
Neither one changes
questions.correct: The one in sugar syrup

questions.text: In which direction does phloem carry sugar?
options: From sources to sinks, up or down
Only upward from roots to leaves
Only downward from flowers to roots
Only sideways between two leaves
questions.correct: From sources to sinks, up or down

questions.text: What is transpiration?
options: Water vapor escaping from leaves
Sugar moving from leaves to roots
Roots absorbing minerals from soil
Leaves making glucose from light
questions.correct: Water vapor escaping from leaves

questions.text: Which property lets water rise as one column in xylem?
options: Water molecules sticking together
Water molecules pushing each other apart
Sugar in the xylem pulling water downward
Gravity pushing water up from the roots
questions.correct: Water molecules sticking together

questions.text: Which organ anchors a plant and stores food in kamote?
options: Root
Stem
Leaf
Flower
questions.correct: Root

questions.text: A plant is moved from a humid greenhouse to a hot, windy rooftop. What should the gardener expect, and what should he do?
options: Faster water loss — water more often and give shade
Slower water loss — water much less often in the strong heat
No change — plants do not respond to wind or heat
Faster growth — remove the shade to speed it up
questions.correct: Faster water loss — water more often and give shade

questions.text: Bark-stripping goats girdled several young mango trees. Why might the trees survive if the bark ring is quickly bridged with grafted bark?
options: The graft reconnects the phloem so sugar reaches the roots
The graft adds new xylem that carries sugar up to the leaves fast
The graft blocks water so the roots stop drowning
The graft makes the leaves stop photosynthesis
questions.correct: The graft reconnects the phloem so sugar reaches the roots

questions.text: Which response helps the body LOSE heat?
options: Vasodilation of skin blood vessels
Vasoconstriction of skin vessels
Shivering of the large skeletal muscles
Goosebumps raising the body hair
questions.correct: Vasodilation of skin blood vessels

questions.text: What do antibodies do?
options: Tag specific germs for destruction
Carry oxygen to all the body's tissues
Send nerve signals to the brain
Produce sweat on the skin surface
questions.correct: Tag specific germs for destruction

questions.text: What is the role of the lymphatic system in immunity?
options: Filters fluid and helps immune cells meet germs
Pumps blood through all the arteries and the veins
Breaks down food into nutrients for cells
Releases hormones that control body growth
questions.correct: Filters fluid and helps immune cells meet germs

questions.text: During an asthma attack, which structures narrow?
options: Bronchioles
Alveoli
Arteries of the arm
Kidneys
questions.correct: Bronchioles

questions.text: After a torn ACL, an athlete rests for months and gains weight. Which BEST explains the weight gain?
options: Less activity means less energy used by muscles
The torn ligament stores extra fat in the knee
The knee produces hormones that add body weight
Rest makes the stomach digest food faster
questions.correct: Less activity means less energy used by muscles

questions.text: A community has low vaccination rates and a measles outbreak. Which action is MOST effective?
options: A catch-up vaccination drive for children
Closing windows to keep the virus outside
Giving antibiotics to every child daily
Waiting for children to build immunity naturally
questions.correct: A catch-up vaccination drive for children

questions.text: Which gases trap heat in the atmosphere?
options: Carbon dioxide and methane
Nitrogen and argon gases
Oxygen and hydrogen gases only
Helium and neon gases
questions.correct: Carbon dioxide and methane

questions.text: Why does deforestation add to climate change?
options: Fewer trees absorb CO₂, and burning releases more
Trees produce most of the methane in the air
Forests block sunlight from reaching the nearby oceans
Cutting trees makes the soil absorb more CO₂
questions.correct: Fewer trees absorb CO₂, and burning releases more

questions.text: What is coral bleaching?
options: Corals expelling their algae in warm water
Corals being painted white by divers
Corals growing faster in cold water
Corals turning into white sand during strong storms
questions.correct: Corals expelling their algae in warm water

questions.text: Why is the Philippines highly vulnerable to climate change?
options: Long coasts, many typhoons, farm- and fishing-based jobs
It has no coastlines at all and is very far from any ocean
It has a cold climate with heavy snowfall
Its people do not depend on farming or fishing
questions.correct: Long coasts, many typhoons, farm- and fishing-based jobs

questions.text: Over 30 years, a lowland frog species has disappeared from low forests but appears in higher ones. Which conclusion is BEST supported?
options: It shifted its range upward as lowlands warmed
It evolved into a new species in one season
It was carried uphill by strong typhoon winds over time
It moved because higher forests are noisier
questions.correct: It shifted its range upward as lowlands warmed

questions.text: A post says one very cold week proves global warming is fake. Which evaluation is BEST?
options: Invalid — climate is judged by long-term trends, not one week
Valid — any cold week disproves warming everywhere
Valid — climate scientists only ever study one week of data at a time
Invalid — because cold weeks never happen anymore
questions.correct: Invalid — climate is judged by long-term trends, not one week

questions.text: Which law is the Philippine Climate Change Act?
Which is an ADAPTATION strategy?
options: Planting flood-tolerant rice varieties
Switching from coal to solar power plants
Reducing car use by walking or biking
Cutting food waste to lower methane
questions.correct: Planting flood-tolerant rice varieties

questions.text: How do Marine Protected Areas help fishers?
options: Fish grow and spill over into nearby fishing areas
Fishers may catch any amount inside the area
Fish are moved to other countries for safekeeping each year
Nets are made larger so fewer fish escape
questions.correct: Fish grow and spill over into nearby fishing areas

questions.text: Which is a MITIGATION strategy?
options: Using renewable energy
Building tall seawalls
Elevating houses on stilts
Storing rainwater
questions.correct: Using renewable energy

questions.text: A city's population doubles, and its river becomes heavily polluted. Which factor MOST directly links the two?
options: More untreated sewage and waste entering the river
More people drinking water from bottled sources
More rain falling because of the larger population
More fish living in the river because of food scraps
questions.correct: More untreated sewage and waste entering the river

questions.text: Your barangay floods often and has many unemployed fishers. Which plan BEST combines adaptation, mitigation and livelihood?
options: Mangrove replanting plus community-run fish sanctuaries
Concrete seawall built along the entire coast and nothing else
Coal plant built to give fishers factory jobs
Draining the wetlands to build a shopping center
questions.correct: Mangrove replanting plus community-run fish sanctuaries
